plain_english_summary: This is a student contents policy from Kestrel Home Insurance (Fictional) covering your belongings inside your flat against events like fire, flood, theft and vandalism, plus accidental damage, up to GBP 6,000 in total and GBP 1,500 per item. You pay GBP 8.50 a month and the first GBP 100 of each claim. Theft is only covered if there was forced and violent entry, and nothing is covered if the flat is empty for more than 60 days in a row. Cover for items away from home and bicycles depends on a separate Endorsement Schedule PP1 that is not included in this document.
